  PROBLEM: The live hook lacks the template's stamp-status validation (isinstance guard and "no valid status" branch). A missing or unknown string status falls through to FINDING_STAMP_FAILURES and gives DECISION_CONTEXT_ONLY, and a list or object status raises TypeError at `status in PASSING_STAMP_STATUSES`, which cmd_hook's fail-open handler (lines 1295-1299) turns into a warning with no permission decision.
  WHY: The push proceeds instead of asking for confirmation, contrary to the README and template behaviour.   WHY: An unhashable stamp value silently bypasses the gate. Reviewer rated it MAJOR; mapped to high.

  WHY: Operators relying on the README or `agents.d/auto-mode-hook-prompts.md:43-47` will mispredict their session's behaviour. Reviewer rated it MAJOR; mapped to high.
